```{r}

library(here)
library(gt)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)


```



```{r}

# Read the Excel files into R
job_prep_demographics <- read_excel(here("data", "Job Prep Demographics.xlsx"))
job_prep_gpa_data <- read_excel(here("data", "Job Prep GPA Data.xlsx"))
job_prep_survey_results <- read_excel(here("data", "Job Prep Survey Results.xlsx"))

# Write the data to CSV files in the 'data' folder
write_csv(job_prep_demographics, here("data", "Job_Prep_Demographics.csv"))
write_csv(job_prep_gpa_data, here("data", "Job_Prep_GPA_Data.csv"))
write_csv(job_prep_survey_results, here("data", "Job_Prep_Survey_Results.csv"))

# Read the CSV files into R using the 'here' package with the correct path
job_prep_demographics <- read_csv(here("data", "Job_Prep_Demographics.csv"))
job_prep_gpa_data <- read_csv(here("data", "Job_Prep_GPA_Data.csv"))
job_prep_survey_results <- read_csv(here("data", "Job_Prep_Survey_Results.csv"))

# View the first few rows of each dataset to confirm they loaded correctly
head(job_prep_demographics)
head(job_prep_gpa_data)
head(job_prep_survey_results)

```


```{r}

# Function to check for problems with the dataset after reading
check_problems <- function(df, file_name) {
  problems <- problems(df)
  if (nrow(problems) > 0) {
    print(paste("Problems in", file_name, ":"))
    print(problems)
  } else {
    print(paste("No problems found in", file_name))
  }
}

# Read the CSV files using 'here' package
job_prep_demographics <- read_csv(here("data", "Job_Prep_Demographics.csv"))
job_prep_gpa_data <- read_csv(here("data", "Job_Prep_GPA_Data.csv"))
job_prep_survey_results <- read_csv(here("data", "Job_Prep_Survey_Results.csv"))

# Check for problems with each dataset
check_problems(job_prep_demographics, "Job_Prep_Demographics.csv")
check_problems(job_prep_gpa_data, "Job_Prep_GPA_Data.csv")
check_problems(job_prep_survey_results, "Job_Prep_Survey_Results.csv")

# Check for missing values
check_missing(job_prep_demographics)
check_missing(job_prep_gpa_data)
check_missing(job_prep_survey_results)

# Check for duplicate rows
check_duplicates(job_prep_demographics)
check_duplicates(job_prep_gpa_data)
check_duplicates(job_prep_survey_results)

# Check for data types
check_data_types(job_prep_demographics)
check_data_types(job_prep_gpa_data)
check_data_types(job_prep_survey_results)

# Summary statistics for numerical columns
check_summary_stats(job_prep_demographics)
check_summary_stats(job_prep_gpa_data)
check_summary_stats(job_prep_survey_results)

# Check for outliers in numerical columns
check_outliers(job_prep_demographics)
check_outliers(job_prep_gpa_data)
check_outliers(job_prep_survey_results)

```
